notes: SeedClock (SCLOCK) targets Ethereum mainnet (chain ID 1). Deploy these two contracts consecutively in one atomic factory transaction, with no untrusted call between them: SeedClock's constructor consumes RoyaltyDistributor's transient binding capability. Both use $owner as the immutable treasury, receiving the 55 reserve NFTs. No post-deployment initialization or funding is required. SeedClock caps supply at 5555 and opens the remaining 5500 to free minting by wallets holding at least one IMD, with a lifetime public mint limit of five per wallet. The fixed 690 bps royalty recipient is RoyaltyDistributor; secondary transfers use the fixed OpenSea strict validator. Holder claims use receipt snapshots for ETH and sync-time snapshots for ERC20 royalties, in batches of up to 64 receipts; rounding dust accrues to token 1's snapshot holder. Neither contract has an owner or withdrawal administrator. Animated SVG rendering and deterministic timestamp-based seed derivation are internal to SeedClock.
